chars.R: RACHID: a young Moroccan man wearing a bright red tracksuit jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves, black jogging trousers and white sneakers.
chars.T: TENNIS STAR: a tall slim woman tennis player in a white tennis dress and a white visor, holding a tennis racket.
chars.G: GUARD: a huge broad-shouldered security guard wearing a black polo shirt, black trousers, an orange armband and a curly earpiece wire.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a big tennis stadium in Paris: RACHID sits in the front VIP row, starstruck with his mouth wide open, staring at TENNIS STAR who is serving on the clay court just in front of him, while GUARD stands right behind RACHID's seat, arms crossed, frowning suspiciously at him.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of RACHID sitting in a padded VIP stadium seat, leaning forward, dreamy love-struck face with small hearts floating around his head, the clay tennis court and crowd blurred behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: RACHID lounges proudly in a luxurious VIP box of a tennis stadium, legs crossed, arms spread on the seat backs, smiling smugly, surrounded by empty fancy seats and a small table with drinks, the tennis court far below.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Funny moment: RACHID in the elegant VIP box holds a small glass of Moroccan mint tea and a boiled egg, grinning, very out of place among the luxury seats and golden railings, tennis court in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Two big security guards (both GUARD) suddenly stand over RACHID's VIP seat, one on each side, looking down at him sternly; RACHID freezes, eyes wide, holding his tea glass. Tennis stadium background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the VIP aisle of the tennis stadium, GUARD points at a paper ticket in RACHID's hand and asks angrily; RACHID raises his chin with fake confidence, one hand on his chest.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: RACHID smiles nervously and shows GUARD his phone screen as proof (screen is blank glowing), while GUARD squints at him, clearly not believing him. Tennis stadium VIP area background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GUARD comes back and firmly waves RACHID to follow him with two fingers; RACHID's smile disappears and he slowly stands up from his VIP seat, worried.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow grey concrete corridor under the tennis stadium, GUARD speaks into a black walkie-talkie radio while gripping RACHID's arm; RACHID is sweating and shocked, mouth open, other security guards approaching in the background.
